coverage: Independent Clang/LLD byte comparison covers all machine arithmetic, immediate, load/store forms, Jalr, Ecall, Unimp, every fixed conditional expansion, forward call/address and backward jump beyond 4 KiB.
QEMU executes 78 constant patterns including highest bit, all ones and low-12 carry boundaries; stdout is compared against host-constructed little-endian u64 values.
QEMU executes long calls, address equality, forward/backward branches, all four condition types and checks t0..t5 survive control expansions.
ELF header, all three PT_LOAD permissions/alignment/filesz/memsz, entry, zero padding and deterministic repeated output checked across 4 KiB boundaries.
Invalid registers/immediates, duplicate/missing/empty labels, nonexistent/end entry, base alignment/address overflow and >64 MiB text rejected.
limitations: Machine-level tests only; real .vt pipeline integration belongs to I.
No source static/BSS, ABS64, object files, general assembler, OS or self-hosting.
Build emits machine bytes without external tools; tests deliberately require Clang/LLD and QEMU and fail if absent.
64 MiB bound test allocates a large input Program but rejection occurs before code output allocation.
